mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_operation_log WHERE log_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_operation_log ( user_id, operation_type, operation_target, target_id, permission_code, operation_data, result, error_message, ip_address, operation_time ) VALUES ( (SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}), #{operationType}, #{operationTarget}, #{targetId}, #{permissionCode}, #{operationData}, #{result}, #{errorMessage}, #{ipAddress}, #{operationTime} )
